title: PRESS · PULL · PUMP
vibe: GREEN · HEAVY UPPER + PUMP (legs & run kept easy on purpose)
why: You want to keep pushing, so we push, just not into the same beat-up system. Your legs and your running engine took a real hit this week (two 2-mile tempos back to back plus the carries), and your last actual upper-strength day was 07-09, over a week ago. So today the intensity goes to the top half: heavy double presses and heavy rows first, then a bodybuilding-style 6-12-25 pump finisher to torch the shoulders, back, and arms. Legs stay quiet on purpose so they recover while you still get to grind hard. Grip work is baked into the core block since you asked for more of it. If you run at all, it's easy Zone 2 only, no third tempo this week. Mobility opens it (shoulder-biased today), core closes it. Read as GREEN off your check-in; if you actually woke up beat up, cut the strength to 4 sets and skip the run.

blocks.title: MOBILITY WARM-UP
blocks.meta: ~10 min · standing rule · shoulder + thoracic biased for an upper day
blocks.text: Pulse first: easy jog OR jumping jacks / arm swings 3 min. Then Original Strength resets: diaphragmatic breathing x5 · head nods + rotations 5 each · quadruped rock-backs x10 · segmental rolling 3/side. Then prep the pressing shoulders hard (they were sore 07-15, warm them properly): thoracic open-books 6/side · cat-cow x8 · scapular CARs 5/side · wall slides x10 · band-free face-pull motion x15 · deep lunge with a reach 4/side · a few light empty-hand press + row patterns. The shoulders do all the work today, so open them up fully before loading.

blocks.title: HEAVY PRESS + PULL
blocks.meta: ~20 min · 2x40 lb + 50 lb DB · push the load
blocks.workRest: 5 rounds · alternate A1/A2 · rest 90-120s · leave 1 rep in the tank

items.name: A1 · Double Military Press
items.detail: 2x40 (80 lb) · 5 x 5 · strict, brace, own the lockout

items.name: A2 · Heavy DB Row
items.detail: 50 lb · 5 x 8/side · full stretch at the bottom, drive the elbow past the hip

blocks.text: This is the push. Strict double press has been sitting for over a week, so go get it: 5 sets of 5, heavy, grind the last reps but keep them clean. If 5 strict starts to fail, switch to a push press for the final 2 sets and keep the load on. Row heavy with the 50, full range, no yanking. Legs stay out of it today on purpose so all your intensity goes into the top half.

blocks.title: THE 6-12-25 PUMP
blocks.workRest: flow 6 → 12 → 25 with NO rest inside the set · rest 90s between rounds · chase the burn
blocks.text: The 6-12-25 method straight from the bodybuilding world: heavy six, moderate twelve, light twenty-five, back to back to back with no rest inside the giant set. One round nukes the shoulders, chest, and triceps. Three rounds total, 90s rest between. The last 5 push-ups each round should be an ugly fight, that is the point. If push-ups die, drop to your knees and finish the 25. This is your pump and your conditioning in one, no treadmill needed.

blocks.title: EASY ZONE 2 — OPTIONAL
blocks.workRest: one easy continuous effort — or skip it entirely
blocks.text: You'll want to run, so here's the deal: if you run today it is EASY Zone 2 only, conversational pace, 6.0-6.3 mph, not a click faster. You already banked two hard 2-milers back to back this week and your legs need the break, so today's run is active recovery, NOT a third tempo. If you'd rather protect the recovery, skip it or just do a 5-min incline walk at 3 mph / 10%. Do not race this one. The push today already happened up top.

blocks.title: CORE + GRIP FINISHER
blocks.meta: ~8 min · anti-rotation + the grip work you wanted · standing rule

items.name: Farmer Hold
items.detail: 2x40 (80 lb) · 45s · crush the handles, stand tall

items.name: Hollow Rock
items.detail: 15 · ribs down, low back glued to the floor

items.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
items.detail: 20 total · hips dead still, no rock

blocks.text: Your end-of-session midline block, with the grip work built in since you loved it on 07-15. The farmer hold hammers your forearms and grip while bracing the whole trunk. Hollow rocks are anti-extension, shoulder taps are anti-rotation. Brace hard, quality over speed, 3 solid rounds.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Walk 2 min @ 3 mph. Then open the worked shoulders and chest: doorway pec stretch 30s/side · cross-body shoulder stretch 30s/side · overhead triceps stretch 30s/side · child's pose 45s · thread-the-needle 5/side · 5 slow breaths. Spend the time on whatever pressing muscle is most cooked.

timer.emomUnit: reps / load today — no metcon clock
